regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative China A-share tape: only Coal (rank 1) and Banks (rank 2) clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and 18 of 22 themes are ineligible. Critically, gate_helps is false for this market — the backtest shows the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown here (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so even the one validated edge is absent locally; this is an experimental/display state, not an alpha source.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (rank 2, crowded, strongest durability) hand off leadership to Coal (rank 1, not crowded, mean-revert) — a CONFIRMED handoff would show the Coal-to-Banks score margin widening beyond 0.065 while Banks' crowding_z stays elevated; retire the watch if the margin closes back under 0.03.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only top-ranked, eligible, scorable theme. Leadership is supported by the momentum rank (1.095, rank 1) and a one-narrative structure, but durability is weak (durability_bar 0.54 near the eligibility floor) and hurst_tag is mean-revert, which fits a choppy China tape. The lean is a continuation-of-leadership hypothesis, not a return forecast.
evidence: hurst_tag mean-revert — consistent with the gate_helps=false regime
breadth 0.5, crowded false (no reflexivity cap needed)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus marginal durability and a false-gate regime means Coal's leadership could whipsaw quickly; a coal spike may simply mark a cyclical top in an unscheduled-news-driven tape.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the strongest durability story in the book (durability_bar 0.78, hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.944) but are crowded (crowding_z 1.74, crowded true). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade. The lean is that Banks remain a viable leadership leg for a trend-follower willing to accept the crowding cap.
evidence: crowding_z 1.74, crowded true — size-down, do not fade
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.74 marks late-stage attention; reflexivity means Banks could reverse sharply without the trend gate offering drawdown protection in this market.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.
